institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

professional-experience-faster.title: Mentioning specific years of professional experience predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
professional-experience-faster.body: Quantifying professional experience or tenure in a field accelerates the funding process for both men and women.

men-marital-status.body: Male borrowers who explicitly state their marital status may see faster funding.

men-family-wellbeing.body: Male borrowers who focus on children or family well-being may fund faster.

female-specific-ages-faster.body: Female borrowers who include specific ages for themselves or their children may fund faster.

female-future-savings-slower.body: Female borrowers mentioning dreams of saving for the future may fund slower.

male-hardship-details-slower.body: Male borrowers who provide extensive details on location or personal hardships may fund slower.

male-brevity-faster.body: Shorter pitch texts may predict faster funding for male borrowers.

women-assets-experience.title: Female borrowers who list specific assets or professional backgrounds may fund faster.
women-assets-experience.retrospective: Promoted and generalized to a gender-neutral claim after corroboration in male pairs.
